Located dockside of the Springhill Suites Hotel, Mile Marker has the best patio dining view around — overlooking the Wharf’s Marina. Dining inside offers a pleasant experience with an upscale appearance, while serving casual culinary cuisine and handcrafted cocktails.This hidden gem is the perfect place to visit, whether you're docking from a sunset or dolphin cruise, enjoying date night with your significant other, or even hosting a bridal shower, wedding reception, or business luncheon.Not only does MM 158 create a relaxing dining experience, they can also accommodate large gatherings and caterings.
